The '''Ploo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Ploo sector/Legends|Ploo sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was home to the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]] and [[Ploo IV/Legends|Ploo IV]].

Species hailing from this system included [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrians]], [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphids]], and immigrated [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]].

==History==
[[File:Ploo-FF1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Ploo system and its surroundings]]
In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] pursued [[Norval]] in the Ploo system. The young man had stolen a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron of King Adas|holocron]] and was trying to reach [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of his mentor [[Murk Lundi]]. Kenobi boarded Norval's vessel and took the holocron after defeating the aspiring [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in a brief [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]].<ref name="Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>
